implementationReview.scope: Independent Atlas maintenance and reader code only

findings.change: Conservative groups bind all test/helpers/fixtures, repository docs/scripts/config and the selected file; selected pure redaction groups declare reviewed dependencies.
Bindings require matching source inputs, literal title or a unique parameterized registration location with column; same-line declarations cannot borrow another result.
findings.test: test/relations.test.mjs: two declarations on one line cannot lend one passing result to the other

findings.change: AST records the actual each registration call site separately from the table start; fresh execution collection carries that site.
findings.test: test/relations.test.mjs: parameterized cases use the real registration call site, not the each table start

findings.change: Failure finalization recomputes result digest/counts and persists normalized result; unavailable after-input is explicit null and cannot pass.
findings.test: test/maintenance.test.mjs: an interrupted after-input observation remains a valid failed report, never a passing one

findings.change: Reading claims cannot exceed the review proof depth; delta provenance must match the exact previous hash.
findings.test: test/maintenance.test.mjs: review proof cannot be upgraded from partial to full by editing the reading claim

findings.change: Reader anchors use parent heading paths and occurrence distinction; search preserves diagnostic underscores and prioritizes scenario prose.
findings.test: test/reader.test.ts: duplicate subheadings resolve under their own parent and diagnostic underscores survive snippets
